experiments.scope: 256 fixed-budget birthday batches on the exact md5-s8-prefix-v1 target. Each batch uses one organizer seed and 256 counter-derived 16-bit values. All trials, including failures, are returned.
experiments.hypothesis: The submitted batch algorithm returns a full ordinary collision with probability at least 0.39 over a fresh uniform 256-bit attack seed. Finite frequencies are supporting evidence, not a certified population probability.
